#### What would you like to be added:

Add swap memory to the Kubelet stats API so that we have metrics on swap utilization.

- Code changes
- Add e2e coverage

review_comments:
I think we should probably create a new e2e test rather than modifying the existing stats tests to run with swap.

We can tag the test with `[Feature:NodeSwap]` or something similar to ensure that this is only run in environments that have swap present.
Yes, it would be better, I will add a new swap test. Thanks for the suggestion.

We are already getting this data from cadvisor so we don't need to do anything special, it should come with the rest of our memory stats already: https://github.com/google/cadvisor/blob/b8e5d34f2357154259c71288663bf79b2cff7c31/container/libcontainer/handler.go#L801-L845
Can you add that this is currently alpha and include the feature gate it's controlled by?
This needs to first land in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105271, then we can rebase this PR to be much smaller
But this PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105271 has not been merged, we need to wait for it to be merged?
It would be better if that one merged first, it will simplify this one once it's rebased.
